text_block_list.text:
From down the hallway,
I could hear Daring Heart's cheerful voice.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: Today we're sitting at the table in the back of the cafeteria, right?

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text: Yeah! Craft and the others should have saved us some seats!
choice_data_list: Hey, you all look like you're having a lot of fun
Hey, you all look like you're having a lot of fun, huh?

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Hey! Trainer.
We're having a study session now.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: I thought we could teach each other to prepare for the upcoming short quiz.
choice_data_list: Everyone's such hard workers, aren't they?

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text: Heheh, of course! We four are going to sweep the top spots on the next quiz.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text: Of course, I'm the best, though, right?

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: Heart-san, Messiah-san, over here~!

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Thank you.
Did I keep you waiting?

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
No, don't worry!
We just got here too.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text: Well, now that everyone's here, shall we begin?

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
"—The present perfect here
means 'it has been continuing the whole time.'"

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
Ah, so that's why it's number 4.
It was the continuous form, I see.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
She really is dependable.
When in doubt with English, Heart-san's the one to ask.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Heheh. Leave it to me!
If it's English, I've got you covered.
(Snort!)

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
It's been 90 minutes.
Shall we take a break around here?

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
That's true.
I might be feeling a bit hungry myself.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text: In that case, I have just the thing.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text: Look! Cookies made with Grandma's secret recipe! I baked them so we could all share♪

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text: Wah! Heart-san, thank you.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Oh? Craft.
What are you doing?

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
This? "Animal Hopping Battle"!
I'm totally hooked on it lately~♪

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
"There are some characters here Heart-san might like too.
Look, like this frog one!"

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
"Wow... how cute!
That frog has quite an expressive face."

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
"The action looks pretty deep, and it seems fun.
I'm in too!"

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Ah! In that case, want to play together?
This game has co-op mode, too!

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Oh, sounds great!
In that case, let's all do it together!

I wonder how Daring Heart and the others are doing?
Thinking this, I head over to the cafeteria—

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
Cesario-san and I will hold them off.
You two take that opening to—

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text: "Okay! Craft, over here!"

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Yay, we did it~~!!
We defeated the boss, Heart-san!!

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Yeah!!
That was some great teamwork!
choice_data_list: Um... wasn't this supposed to be a study session?

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text: Oh! Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Fufu. Resting is part of strategy, too.
Staring at your desk forever won't help
keep your mind sharp, you know.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
“Still, I suppose
I got a little carried away.”

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. Just being together with everyone
makes me relax before I even realize it.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
"Is this what they call
'kindred spirits' in Japanese, I wonder?"

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text: When the four of us are together, everything is so much fun♪
choice_data_list: Since you understand each other so well, you can really go all out.
Since you know each other so well, you can really go all out, huh?
Can I take a look at how your game is going?

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text: When the four of us are together, everything is so much fun♪
choice_data_list: Since you understand each other so well, you can really go all out.
Since you know each other so well, you can really go all out, huh?
Can I take a look at how your game is going?

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text: Yes. Play hard and study hard, right?

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text: “—Alright, break time's over! Next up is co-op study time!”

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. Now that we've taken a break,
let's give the rest our all.

Daring Heart and the others return to their studies.
Though rivals on the track, seeing them learn together like this warmed the heart.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text: Yes, I don't mind at all.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
"Let's go for one more match.
With the four of us, there's no way we could lose."

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Of cooourse!
Let's win again, Heart-san!

Classmates who clash fiercely during races
were now simply laughing together as friends.
It was a heartwarming sight to behold.
